title: Euplotes focardii RNA Extraction
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.hhwb37e

steps.title: Collect cells by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Filter and collect approximately 40 000 Euplotes focardii cells, then centrifuge at 4 °C for 5 min at 3000 rpm.

steps.title: Lyse cells in Trizol
steps.instruction: Dissolve the cell pellet in 750 µl Trizol reagent (3 vol Trizol : 1 vol cells) and vortex for 2 min.

steps.title: Add chloroform and vortex
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 5 min, add 200 µl chloroform, and vortex for 15 seconds.

steps.title: Incubate and centrifuge for phase separation
steps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 15 min, then centrifuge at 4 °C for 20 min at 12 000 rpm.

steps.title: Transfer aqueous phase and precipitate RNA
steps.instruction: Move the upper aqueous supernatant to a new tube and precipitate RNA by adding isopropanol in a 1:1 volume ratio.

steps.title: Incubate and centrifuge RNA pellet
steps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 10 min, then centrifuge at 4 °C for 30 min at 13 000 rpm and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash RNA pellet with ethanol
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA pellet twice with 1 ml 75 % ethanol (in DPEC water), centrifuging each wash for 5 min at 8000 rpm, then let the pellet air‑dry.

steps.title: Resuspend RNA and heat
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried RNA pellet in 20–30 µl DPEC water and incubate for 10 min at 55–60 °C.

steps.title: Treat RNA with DNase I
steps.instruction: Treat the RNA sample with DNase I to remove genomic DNA.
